content.value_statement: Video ad requirements vary by platform, making creative adaptation slow and error-prone. This skill provides specifications, story structures, and generation workflows for efficient production.
actual_capabilities: Lists aspect ratios, resolutions, duration limits, audio behavior, and safe zones for five major advertising platforms.
Maps video concepts to TikTok, Instagram Reels, Stories, YouTube, Facebook, and LinkedIn formats.
Structures 15 to 30 second ads with the AIDA framework and timed scene guidance.
Provides Belt CLI examples for video generation, voiceover, audio merging, and captioning.
Recommends hooks, captions, calls to action, and platform-specific production checks.
limitations: Platform rules can change, so current advertising documentation must be checked before production.
The skill requires the external Belt CLI and compatible inference.sh services for generation examples.
It does not upload campaigns, manage advertising accounts, or measure performance.
Generated media quality and licensing depend on the selected external model and service terms.

use_cases.title: Adapt a Paid Campaign
use_cases.description: Convert one campaign concept into correctly framed versions for multiple social advertising platforms.

use_cases.title: Build a Timed Storyboard
use_cases.description: Turn a product brief into scenes, voiceover, captions, and a clear call to action.

use_cases.title: Check Creative Before Launch
use_cases.description: Review dimensions, duration, safe zones, audio, and caption requirements before delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Platform Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a specification checklist for a [duration]-second [platform] ad promoting [product]. Include aspect ratio, resolution, safe zones, captions, audio, and CTA timing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a first ad on one platform.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Platforms
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [platform one] and [platform two] requirements for [campaign]. Recommend format, duration, framing, caption placement, and changes needed for each version.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when adapting one concept to two placements.

prompt_templates.title: Build an AIDA Storyboard
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a [duration]-second AIDA storyboard for [product] on [platform]. Give each scene a timestamp, visual direction, voiceover, caption, and call to action.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this to move from a brief to a production plan.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Platform Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Design platform-specific versions of [campaign] for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, Facebook, and LinkedIn. Provide timed scenes, generation prompts, voiceover, captions, safe-zone notes, and production checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for coordinated campaign production across major platforms.

output_examples.input: Plan a 15-second TikTok ad for a wireless charging dock.
output: Format: 9:16 at 1080 x 1920, with key text at least 150 pixels from every edge.
0-3 seconds: Show tangled cables and ask, "Still charging like this?"
3-11 seconds: Reveal the charging dock and demonstrate the organized setup.
11-15 seconds: Display the product name, price, and "Shop now" call to action.
Add large captions and design the audio for both sound-on and muted viewing.

output_examples.input: Adapt a software demo for a YouTube bumper and Facebook feed.
output: YouTube bumper: Use 16:9, six seconds, one product benefit, and one closing call to action.
Facebook feed: Use 4:5, 15 seconds, immediate problem framing, captions, a short demonstration, and a final offer.
Keep each version independently framed instead of cropping one shared master.

best_practices: Confirm current platform rules before production because dimensions and duration limits can change.
Design for silent viewing with concise captions, readable contrast, and important content outside interface overlays.
Create separate platform versions instead of cropping one master video into every format.
anti_patterns: Do not place key text near screen edges or platform interface controls.
Do not delay the hook or call to action beyond the recommended viewing window.
Do not reuse unsupported performance claims or unverified testimonials in ad scripts.

faq.question: Which advertising platforms are covered?
faq.answer: The skill covers TikTok, Instagram Reels, Instagram Stories, YouTube, Facebook Feed, and LinkedIn.

faq.question: Can this skill generate finished video files?
faq.answer: It provides Belt CLI workflows for generation, voiceover, merging, and captions. Successful output requires supported inference.sh services.

faq.question: Does the skill publish advertising campaigns?
faq.answer: No. It supports creative planning and production but does not access advertising accounts or publish campaigns.

faq.question: Are the platform specifications always current?
faq.answer: No. Platform requirements can change, so official advertising documentation should be checked before final delivery.

faq.question: Does every ad need captions?
faq.answer: Captions are strongly recommended because many social videos autoplay without sound and must remain understandable when muted.

faq.question: What information should a prompt include?
faq.answer: Provide the product, audience, offer, target platform, desired duration, key benefit, and call to action.
